lines.raw: In one sentence: US healthcare runs on acronyms, and most of them belong to one of five groups: **counting people and money**, **how providers are paid**, **quality and risk**, **pharmacy**, and **data files**.
lines.say: In one sentence: U S healthcare runs on acronyms, and most of them belong to one of five groups: counting people and money, how providers are paid, quality and risk, pharmacy, and data files.

lines.raw: Your lookup table.
lines.say: Your lookup table.

lines.raw: US healthcare acronyms A to Z.
lines.say: U S healthcare acronyms A to Z.

lines.raw: ACA. Stands for: Affordable Care Act. One-line meaning: 2010 law: marketplaces, pre-existing condition protections. Taught in: Lesson 5 of this course.
lines.say: A C A. Stands for: Affordable Care Act. One-line meaning: 2010 law: marketplaces, pre-existing condition protections. Taught in: Lesson 5 of this course.

lines.raw: ACO. Stands for: Accountable Care Organization. One-line meaning: Providers sharing responsibility for cost and quality. Taught in: Value Based Care course.
lines.say: A C O. Stands for: Accountable Care Organization. One-line meaning: Providers sharing responsibility for cost and quality. Taught in: Value Based Care course.

lines.raw: Capitation. Stands for: (not an acronym). One-line meaning: Provider paid a fixed amount per member per month, used or not. Taught in: Capitation course.
lines.say: Capitation. Stands for: (not an acronym). One-line meaning: Provider paid a fixed amount per member per month, used or not. Taught in: Capitation course.

lines.raw: CHIP. Stands for: Children's Health Insurance Program. One-line meaning: Government coverage for children. Taught in: Lesson 5 of this course.
lines.say: CHIP. Stands for: Children's Health Insurance Program. One-line meaning: Government coverage for children. Taught in: Lesson 5 of this course.

lines.raw: CMS. Stands for: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. One-line meaning: Federal agency that runs Medicare. Taught in: Lesson 5 of this course.
lines.say: C M S. Stands for: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services. One-line meaning: Federal agency that runs Medicare. Taught in: Lesson 5 of this course.

lines.raw: COB. Stands for: Coordination of Benefits. One-line meaning: Rules for who pays first when someone has two plans. Taught in: Eligibility course.
lines.say: C O B. Stands for: Coordination of Benefits. One-line meaning: Rules for who pays first when someone has two plans. Taught in: Eligibility course.

lines.raw: CPT. Stands for: Current Procedural Terminology. One-line meaning: Codes for what the doctor did. Taught in: Medical course.
lines.say: C P T. Stands for: Current Procedural Terminology. One-line meaning: Codes for what the doctor did. Taught in: Medical course.

lines.raw: DRG. Stands for: Diagnosis Related Group. One-line meaning: One payment package for a hospital stay. Taught in: Fee For Service course.
lines.say: D R G. Stands for: Diagnosis Related Group. One-line meaning: One payment package for a hospital stay. Taught in: Fee For Service course.

lines.raw: EDI. Stands for: Electronic Data Interchange. One-line meaning: Standard numbered data files exchanged between payers and providers. Taught in: Interoperability course.
lines.say: E D I. Stands for: Electronic Data Interchange. One-line meaning: Standard numbered data files exchanged between payers and providers. Taught in: Interoperability course.

lines.raw: EOB. Stands for: Explanation of Benefits. One-line meaning: Statement to the member; not a bill. Taught in: Claim Payment course.
lines.say: E O B. Stands for: Explanation of Benefits. One-line meaning: Statement to the member; not a bill. Taught in: Claim Payment course.

lines.raw: EPO. Stands for: Exclusive Provider Organization. One-line meaning: In-network only, usually no referrals. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.
lines.say: E P O. Stands for: Exclusive Provider Organization. One-line meaning: In-network only, usually no referrals. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.

lines.raw: FFS. Stands for: Fee for Service. One-line meaning: Provider paid for each service. Taught in: Fee For Service course.
lines.say: F F S. Stands for: Fee for Service. One-line meaning: Provider paid for each service. Taught in: Fee For Service course.

lines.raw: HCC. Stands for: Hierarchical Condition Category. One-line meaning: Diagnosis groups used in risk adjustment. Taught in: Risk Adjustment course.
lines.say: H C C. Stands for: Hierarchical Condition Category. One-line meaning: Diagnosis groups used in risk adjustment. Taught in: Risk Adjustment course.

lines.raw: HDHP. Stands for: High Deductible Health Plan. One-line meaning: High deductible; allows an HSA. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.
lines.say: H D H P. Stands for: High Deductible Health Plan. One-line meaning: High deductible; allows an H S A. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.

lines.raw: HEDIS. Stands for: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set. One-line meaning: Standard quality measures. Taught in: HEDIS course.
lines.say: HEDIS. Stands for: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set. One-line meaning: Standard quality measures. Taught in: HEDIS course.

lines.raw: HIPAA. Stands for: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act. One-line meaning: 1996 law: privacy and data standards. Taught in: HIPAA course.
lines.say: HIPAA. Stands for: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act. One-line meaning: 1996 law: privacy and data standards. Taught in: HIPAA course.

lines.raw: HMO. Stands for: Health Maintenance Organization. One-line meaning: PCP and referrals, in-network only. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.
lines.say: H M O. Stands for: Health Maintenance Organization. One-line meaning: P C P and referrals, in-network only. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.

lines.raw: HSA. Stands for: Health Savings Account. One-line meaning: Tax-free medical savings with an HDHP. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.
lines.say: H S A. Stands for: Health Savings Account. One-line meaning: Tax-free medical savings with an H D H P. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.

lines.raw: ICD-10. Stands for: International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision. One-line meaning: Diagnosis codes: why care was needed. Taught in: Medical course.
lines.say: I C D 10. Stands for: International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision. One-line meaning: Diagnosis codes: why care was needed. Taught in: Medical course.

lines.raw: MA. Stands for: Medicare Advantage. One-line meaning: Private plans that replace Original Medicare. Taught in: Medicare course.
lines.say: M A. Stands for: Medicare Advantage. One-line meaning: Private plans that replace Original Medicare. Taught in: Medicare course.

lines.raw: MM. Stands for: Member month. One-line meaning: One person covered for one month. Taught in: Eligibility course.
lines.say: M M. Stands for: Member month. One-line meaning: One person covered for one month. Taught in: Eligibility course.

lines.raw: NDC. Stands for: National Drug Code. One-line meaning: ID for a drug product and pack. Taught in: Pharmacy course.
lines.say: N D C. Stands for: National Drug Code. One-line meaning: I D for a drug product and pack. Taught in: Pharmacy course.

lines.raw: NPI. Stands for: National Provider Identifier. One-line meaning: The ID number every US provider uses on claims. Taught in: Provider course.
lines.say: N P I. Stands for: National Provider Identifier. One-line meaning: The I D number every U S provider uses on claims. Taught in: Provider course.

lines.raw: OOP. Stands for: Out of pocket. One-line meaning: What the member pays; the OOP max caps it. Taught in: Lesson 2 of this course.
lines.say: O O P. Stands for: Out of pocket. One-line meaning: What the member pays; the O O P max caps it. Taught in: Lesson 2 of this course.

lines.raw: PBM. Stands for: Pharmacy Benefit Manager. One-line meaning: Runs drug benefits for plans. Taught in: Pharmacy Benefits Manager course.
lines.say: P B M. Stands for: Pharmacy Benefit Manager. One-line meaning: Runs drug benefits for plans. Taught in: Pharmacy Benefits Manager course.

lines.raw: PCP. Stands for: Primary Care Provider. One-line meaning: Your main doctor. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.
lines.say: P C P. Stands for: Primary Care Provider. One-line meaning: Your main doctor. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.

lines.raw: PHI. Stands for: Protected Health Information. One-line meaning: Health data that identifies a person. Taught in: HIPAA course.
lines.say: P H I. Stands for: Protected Health Information. One-line meaning: Health data that identifies a person. Taught in: HIPAA course.

lines.raw: PMPM. Stands for: Per Member Per Month. One-line meaning: Cost ÷ member months. Taught in: Eligibility course.
lines.say: P M P M. Stands for: Per Member Per Month. One-line meaning: Cost ÷ member months. Taught in: Eligibility course.

lines.raw: POS. Stands for: Point of Service / Place of Service. One-line meaning: A plan type, or the care setting on a claim (see below). Taught in: Lesson 3 / Medical course.
lines.say: P O S. Stands for: Point of Service or Place of Service. One-line meaning: A plan type, or the care setting on a claim (see below). Taught in: Lesson 3 or Medical course.

lines.raw: PPO. Stands for: Preferred Provider Organization. One-line meaning: No referrals, out-of-network covered. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.
lines.say: P P O. Stands for: Preferred Provider Organization. One-line meaning: No referrals, out-of-network covered. Taught in: Lesson 3 of this course.

lines.raw: RAF. Stands for: Risk Adjustment Factor. One-line meaning: Risk score; around 1.0 means an average member. Taught in: Risk Adjustment course.
lines.say: R A F. Stands for: Risk Adjustment Factor. One-line meaning: Risk score; around 1.0 means an average member. Taught in: Risk Adjustment course.

lines.raw: VBC. Stands for: Value-Based Care. One-line meaning: Paying for results, not volume. Taught in: Value Based Care course.
lines.say: V B C. Stands for: Value-Based Care. One-line meaning: Paying for results, not volume. Taught in: Value Based Care course.

lines.raw: Watch out: POS has two meanings.
lines.say: Watch out: P O S has two meanings.

lines.raw: On a plan, **POS** means **Point of Service** plan.
lines.say: On a plan, P O S means Point of Service plan.

lines.raw: On a claim, **POS** means **Place of Service**, a short code for where care happened (office, hospital and so on).
lines.say: On a claim, P O S means Place of Service, a short code for where care happened (office, hospital and so on).

lines.raw: Check the context: a plan table or a claim table.
lines.say: Check the context: a plan table or a claim table.

lines.say: Most acronyms fall into five groups: counting and money (M M, P M P M), payment models (F F S, V B C, A C O), quality and risk (HEDIS, Stars, H C C, R A F), pharmacy (P B M, N D C) and data files (E D I).
